title: Just Juice Fusion Berry Burst & Lemonade 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice's Fusion (Berry Burst x Lemonade) e-liquid combines the best of both worlds, blending the vibrant sweetness of ripe berries with the zesty tang of lemonade. The result is a delightful concoction that will awaken your taste buds and leave you craving more. With every puff, you'll experience the juicy burst of berries followed by the invigorating zest of sparkling lemonade. Treat yourself to this fusion of flavours and enjoy the perfect harmony of berries and lemonade. Shortfill bottles from Just Juice E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in shortfills. With blends tailor-made to light up your tastebuds, UK E-liquid legends Just Juice create the tangiest, tastiest, fruitiest flavours around. The flavours are long-lasting, less allergenic and easier on the throat than many alternative e-liquids and come in 50/50, Nicotine Salt and shortfills.
